question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 4.
solution:
The correct answer is '**most**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate word for the given blank is '**most**'.
 
• It means **'extremely; very; to the greatest extent'. **(बहुत ज़्यादा; बहुत; सबसे बड़ी सीमा तक)
 
 
• *Example: The **most **important event of my life.*
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 3.**

 

Correct Passage:__ *I studied at the J.J. School of Art in Mumbai, India’s premier institute __of__ (1) art and design. After two years I __moved to__ (2) New York City to further my studies. I soon __found__ (3) myself in a totally different culture which I embraced the __**most**__ (4) willingly. Interestingly, it was in New York that I began (5)______ different cuisines. *

46:T945,

The correct answer is &a
